sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु संरब्धः कुम्भकर्णं महोदरः।उवाच रक्षसां मध्ये रावणं लोकरावणम् ।। ६.६४.१९ ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu saṁrabdhaḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ mahodaraḥ।uvāca rakṣasāṁ madhye rāvaṇaṁ lokarāvaṇam ।। 6.64.19 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara having spoken to agitated Kumbhakarna in the midst of Rakshasas in this way, submitted to Ravana, who makes people cry.
